claim.description: Synthetic demonstration profile for comparing maintenance policies under declared failure, sensor and crew constraints. It does not estimate a real machine's remaining useful life.
claim.intended_user: Manufacturing reliability engineer reviewing a synthetic maintenance-policy experiment

operating_envelope.domain_description: Synthetic single-machine event semantics with deterministic repair intervals and a declared finite-buffer production policy benchmark.

conditions.support: Synthetic scripted-event domain; no empirical hazard distribution is asserted.
Synthetic repair-duration input; crew/tool queueing is outside the Tier-A reference.
Placeholder normalized corruption envelope only; must be replaced by dataset-specific definitions.
Synthetic resource envelope; no workforce observations are used.

excluded_domains: real machine telemetry and physical sensor calibration
actual remaining useful life or warranty determination
safety-critical machine actuation and product-release decisions
known_counterexamples: A logical alternate path may share a physical fiber duct or power dependency.
A nominal battery capacity may overstate usable energy after derating.

risk_assessment.rationale: Synthetic example only. The profile requests advice and prohibits external action. A real deployment must reassess the consequences, exposed population, failure detectability and fallback independently.

software_conformance.rationale: The fixture illustrates the contract; no executable telecom evaluator is qualified.

numerical_verification.rationale: No telecom known-answer evaluator results are attached.

physical_validation.rationale: No physical or field validation is claimed for the synthetic topology.

data_integrity_rights.rationale: All topology and load values are synthetic; no operator data permission is asserted.

uncertainty_credibility.rationale: Intervals are declared synthetic assumptions, not calibrated uncertainty.

generalization.rationale: No held-out real topology or site evaluation exists in this example.

robustness.rationale: The profile lists counterexamples but includes no executed adversarial results.

operational_assurance.rationale: No operator integration, monitoring, recovery or shadow-pilot evidence exists.

safety_security_authority.rationale: The example is advisory-only and has no production authorization or safety case.

authority.fallback_action: Return indeterminate and request human review when required inputs are missing, stale or outside the declared envelope.

requalification_triggers: change to the evaluator or model
change to topology, load or backup assumptions
revocation_triggers: unresolved critical safety or security issue

claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract-shape example only. It does not establish prognostic accuracy, plant downtime reduction, machine-specific validity, safety certification or qualification for operational maintenance decisions.
